exposure: administration of a mix of pro- and prebiotics during late pregnancy and first 6 months of life
duration of exclusive or total breast-feeding
respiratory infections during the first 2 years of life
allergic diseases or sensitization by the age of 2 or 5 years
cohort: The study included children (n=867 with serum samples, n=11 with confirmed CD) from a larger clinical trial (n=1223) focused on primary allergy prevention.
finding: Administration of a mix of pro- and prebiotics during late pregnancy and the first 6 months of life was not associated with the prevalence of celiac disease or elevated tissue transglutaminase IgA antibodies by 13 years of age.
mod_finding: No association was found between the mode of delivery and the development of celiac disease.
